limitations: Sequential baseline and optimized blocks, not randomized/paired; observed separation is descriptive, not a formal confidence interval.
Automatic verify saved only one 20000-step unit. The user previously supplied successful 16-unit verification separately.
Whole-process counters/profiles include startup and imports; clean RESULT timing is internal to the workload.
Debug sample shares are not release-build Amdahl fractions.
Perf stat TXT and CSV come from independent five-run batches, and reported counts are per-process means; divide by16, not80.
Hardware events multiplexed around40-60%; unsupported LLC and negative topdown values cannot support a detailed hardware bottleneck claim.
Manifest upstream provenance text remains UNVERIFIED; official pyperformance metadata and source hashes are separate evidence, not a saved authenticity gate transcript.
